title: Mouse Behavior in Virtual Reality System under Optogenetic Manipulation via UCNPs
protocol: Inject viruses in M2 area of mouse.
Implant titanium alloy head bar opposite to virus injection side with two skull screws and dental cement before behavior training.
Train mice to run on a jetball for 3 days after recovery, using one-dimension corridor or two-dimension open field scene displayed on VR system screens.
Run head-fixed mice on the jetball for 2 min per session under conditions of no NIR light, 808 nm, 980 nm, 808 nm & 980 nm, and 808 nm & 980 nm & 1532 nm.
Increase power density of NIR light at 980 nm while keeping the power density of NIR light at 808 nm constant for independent multi-color modulation.
Allow mice to rest for more than 5 min between trials, with trial orders randomly chosen.
Record and measure running distances of mice during trials.
